items.detail: Rescheduled! Fishing Derby (Ages 3-16) Grab your gear and make your way to Clearwater Park for a morning of family fishing! Test your skills and maybe even land a “big one”. Pond is stocked with hundreds of fish and worms are provided. Bring your own rod, reel and tackle. Register your child(ren) and bring the family to share in the fun! Dress for the weather. Walk up registration available for $13 while spots last. New Date: October 10 Thank you to our event partner: the Mount Prospect Police Department. Officers will be ready with fishing tips and tales for all! R $11 NR $13 Click here to register!
items.title: Fishing Derby

items.detail: Daddy Daughter Date Night – Ties & Tiaras (Ages 4-12) Step into an unforgettable evening of elegance, laughter, and special memories at our Daddy Daughter Date Night: Ties & Tiaras! Dads, grandpas, uncles, and special father figures are invited to dress to impress alongside their favorite girls for a magical night filled with dinner, dancing, sweet treats, music, games, crafts, and cherished moments together. From sharp ties to sparkling tiaras, this royal evening is all about celebrating your special bond. Join us for a night of fun, laughter, and create memories that will last a lifetime! Purchase tickets on site for a razzle dazzle raffle benefiting the Mt. Prospect Parks Foundation. Register early, the event fills quickly. R $30 NR $40 Click here to register!

items.detail: Ladies Night Out: Harvest & Holiday A Mt. Prospect Parks Foundation Fundraiser! Gather friends and RELAX while you enjoy a beautiful and breathtaking flower presentation by Mary from Lake Zurich Florist. Learn the ins and outs of all occasion floral arranging from wedding and holiday centerpieces to creating lovely at home decor. Your registration includes a glass of wine and charcuterie/sweet treats along with the chance to win one of six fresh centerpieces created right before your eyes! Each piece has a value of $150 to $200. The busiest season is just around the corner….. Take a moment to stop and smell the flowers! Instructor Mary from Lake Zurich Florist Friendship Park Conservatory Ages 21+ Fee $35 Click here to register!
items.title: Ladies Night Out: Harvest & Holiday
